commands.cmd: echo LOG_MTIME=$(stat -c %y /tmp/deploy-setup.log 2>/dev/null); grep -E 'SETUP_EXIT' /tmp/deploy-setup.log 2>/dev/null | tail -2; echo ---; echo SERVICE=$(sudo systemctl is-active control-point); echo SITE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://tryctrlpoint.org); echo BUNDLE=$(grep -o 'index-[A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.js' /opt/control-point/dist/index.html 2>/dev/null | head -1)
